OK: The blue bar to the right of the name, to see at a glance what is biggest.

好: 外观、语言，以及界面上显示哪些内容。用不上的页面、按钮和说明可以关掉，界面更清爽；随时可以回来打开，不会丢任何设置和记录。
OK: Appearance, language and what the window shows. Pages, buttons and descriptions you don't use can be hidden for a cleaner look; turn them back on here at any time, and no settings or records are lost.

好: 外观和语言也可以在这一页上面改；「使用反馈」和「运行记录」也在「帮助」页里。
OK: Appearance and language can also be changed at the top of this page; "Feedback" and "Run log" are also on the "Help" page.
Size on disk and hard links

好: 快速扫描时在名字下面注明：压缩、稀疏和只在云端（OneDrive 等）的文件实际占的盘比文件大小小；WinSxS 这类文件夹里很多文件和系统其他位置是同一份（硬链接），删了也不腾空间。
OK: With the fast scan, note under the name when compressed, sparse and cloud-only (OneDrive and the like) files take less space than their size, and when files in folders such as WinSxS are the same files as elsewhere in Windows (hard links), so deleting them frees nothing.

好: 换了以后本工具会关闭，再用新的语言打开。

OK: Give way to other programs when finding duplicates

好: 每一行前面显示一个复选框，点一下就能多选，不用按住 Ctrl（和资源管理器「查看」里的「项目复选框」一样）。开不开都可以按住右键上下拖，一次选中连着的几行。

好: 直接读取 NTFS 的文件表（MFT），比逐个文件夹查看快得多，还能看出实际占用和硬链接。少数安全软件对直接读盘会提示，可以关掉，改为逐个文件夹扫描。清理、搬家、软件管理统计大小时也按这个设置。
OK: Read the NTFS file table (MFT) directly: much faster than opening every folder, and it also shows size on disk and hard links. A few security programs warn about direct disk reads; turn this off to scan folder by folder instead. Clean up, Moved folders and Apps follow this setting when measuring sizes.

好: 装更新、装驱动之前 Windows 会自动建还原点，系统出问题时可以退回去。还原点放在 C 盘的 System Volume Information 里（空间地图里带小锁的那个文件夹），只记改动过的部分，占的空间有上限，到了上限会自动删掉最旧的。觉得占得多，可以在 Windows 的「系统保护」里点「配置」，调小「最大使用量」，或者删掉这块盘的全部还原点（删了就不能再退回去）。本工具不直接删还原点。
OK: Windows creates restore points automatically before installing updates and drivers, so you can go back if something breaks. They are kept in System Volume Information on C: (the folder with a lock in the space map), store only what changed, and have a size limit; when it is reached, the oldest are deleted automatically. If they take too much space, open Windows' "System Protection", click "Configure" and lower "Max Usage", or delete all restore points for the drive (you can't go back after that). ClearC never deletes restore points itself.

好: 读文件时用 Windows 的后台模式，磁盘和内存都排在其他程序后面：不拖慢正在用的程序，也不把它们缓存在内存里的数据挤掉。电脑空闲时速度基本不受影响，同时在做别的事时查得慢一些。
OK: Read files in Windows' background mode, behind other programs for both disk and memory: the programs you are using don't slow down, and the data they keep cached in memory isn't pushed out. When the PC is idle the speed is about the same; while you do other things, the search takes longer.

好: 跟随系统会照 Windows 设置里「选择应用模式」来。换了以后本工具会关闭，再自动打开。
OK: Follow Windows uses the "Choose your app mode" setting. ClearC closes and reopens after you change it.
